text: {"term":"Leverage Ratio","formula":"Leverage Ratio = (Total Liabilities − SD_adj) ÷ (Tangible Net Worth + SD_adj), where Tangible Net Worth = total members' equity − goodwill − other intangible assets − amounts owing to the Parent or any Subsidiary by any Affiliate, and SD_adj = Subordinated Debt up to US$15,000,000","conditions":["It is determined for the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries as of a date of determination.","Total Liabilities are all liabilities that would appear on a balance sheet prepared under GAAP.","Tangible Net Worth deductions are determined under GAAP.","The Subordinated Debt adjustment applies solely to the Leverage Ratio under Section 6.12(b).","The Subordinated Debt adjustment does not apply to the minimum Tangible Net Worth covenant in Section 6.12(a).","The Subordinated Debt adjustment is capped at an aggregate amount of US$15,000,000.","The same amount added to Tangible Net Worth must be deducted from Total Liabilities.","Subordinated Debt must be Debt of the Parent that is unsecured and subordinated to the Obligations on terms acceptable to the Lender.","The Leverage Ratio is tested at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent.","The Leverage Ratio must not exceed 6.00 to 1.00.","The term \"Debt\" used in the Subordinated Debt definition is not defined in the pages provided."],"parts":[{"clause":"Definition of \"Leverage Ratio\"","quote":"\"Leverage Ratio\" means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) Total Liabilities to (b) Tangible Net Worth, in each case as adjusted under Section 6.12(c) and determined for the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries."},{"clause":"Definition of \"Total Liabilities\"","quote":"\"Total Liabilities\" means, as of any date of determination, all liabilities of the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries that would appear on a balance sheet prepared under GAAP."},{"clause":"Definition of \"Tangible Net Worth\"","quote":"\"Tangible Net Worth\" means, as of any date of determination, the total members' equity of the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries, less (a) goodwill, (b) other intangible assets, and (c) amounts owing to the Parent or any Subsidiary by any Affiliate, in each case determined under GAAP and subject to Section 6.12(c)."},{"clause":"Definition of \"Subordinated Debt\"","quote":"\"Subordinated Debt\" means Debt of the Parent that is unsecured and subordinated to the Obligations on terms acceptable to the Lender."},{"clause":"6.12(c)","quote":"Treatment of Subordinated Debt. Solely for the purpose of calculating the Leverage Ratio under paragraph (b) above, and not for the purpose of paragraph (a) above, (i) Subordinated Debt in an aggregate amount of up to US$15,000,000 shall be added to Tangible Net Worth, and (ii) the same amount of Subordinated Debt shall be deducted from Total Liabilities."},{"clause":"6.12(b)","quote":"Maximum Leverage Ratio. The Leverage Ratio at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent does not exceed 6.00 to 1.00."},{"clause":"Definition of \"Parent\"","quote":"\"Parent\" means Bramble Auto Finance LLC, a Delaware limited liability company."}]}
